assumptions.piezoelectric_vector_mapping: The three supplied e values are interpreted as [e31, e32, e33] in C/m^2; all other entries of the 3x6 eES matrix are zero.
assumptions.constitutive_form: COMSOL stress-charge form: T = cE*S - transpose(eES)*E; D = eES*S + epsilon0*epsilonrS*E.
assumptions.load_case: Uniform follower pressure on the top z face; the bottom z face is fixed and grounded; all other electrostatic boundaries use zero charge.
assumptions.reference_effect: The 2026 ZnO/BiOCl paper is used only as a presentation reference (3D stress and centered potential maps under 100 MPa), not as a quantitative target or heterojunction geometry specification.

BiOCl.source_note: C and epsilon_prompt match the supplied prompt. The extracted VASP piezoelectric tensors are zero, so the nonzero e vector is user-supplied and not traceable to the provided ZIP.

BiOBr.source_note: C matches the supplied VASP ZIP. epsilon_prompt uses only the electronic dielectric tensor, while the VASP total tensor is much larger. The extracted VASP piezoelectric tensors are zero.

BiOI.source_note: C matches the supplied VASP ZIP. epsilon_prompt uses only the electronic dielectric tensor, while the VASP total tensor is much larger. The extracted VASP piezoelectric tensors are zero.

reference_paper.title: Interfacial piezoelectric potential-enhanced Z-scheme charge separation in ZnO/BiOCl heterojunctions for ultrafast antibiotic degradation
